title: 20 ASOS Tactical Operator Kit
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR MOBILITY COMMAND.FA4452  763 ESS
description_text: This is an RFQ for the subject requirement to be awarded in accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) 12 procedures, the terms and conditions, specific information, instructions and evaluation criteria outlined in this RFQ and attachments. The Government intends to award a, single Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Purchase Order for the subject requirement. The 20th Air Support Operations Squadron (ASOS) requires the BNO Tactical Operator Kit containing INVISIO X7 Headsets, V50 4 PTT (2-Com, Gen II), Com Cables (800 MM), and Foam Tips (Snap on).
